signals.thesis: DraftKings surging +11.3% on massive volume as iGaming legalization momentum drives TAM expansion. Technical breakout above 6-week descending trendline resistance at $25.50. Q1 2026 showed first sustained quarterly profitability, validating the unit economics thesis. Volume 4x average confirms institutional participation.

Healthcare sector leading in EARLY RISK-OFF as investors rotate into defensive quality. XLV breaking above both 50-DMA and 200-DMA for dual MA confirmation. UNH recovery and pharma strength driving sector outperformance. Defensive hedge against elevated crisis probability (28.1%).

Semi equipment maker tagging 52-week high ($73.03) as HBM and advanced packaging capex surges. Laser annealing systems critical for next-gen chip miniaturization. Breakout from 3-month base on +10.1% day with volume confirmation. AI capex cycle beneficiary with order backlog visibility.

European semi champion breaking out as EU CHIPS Act subsidies materialize and automotive semiconductor demand recovers. Geographic diversification play providing EU exposure. Benefits from weak EUR boosting export competitiveness. Strong trend with price above all moving averages.
